test.prompt: Use only the configured Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured SOPs source at {{source}}, report its identity, URL, visible structure, and one concise factual observation proving approved process content was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured SOP source is fetched and one source-grounded process observation is returned without a write.
assertions: The configured SOP source is fetched successfully.
The response reports its identity, URL, and visible structure.
The trace contains no write operation.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured SOPs source at {{source}} and inspect whether at least one readable SOP with meaningful content exists. Report counts and content presence only; do not quote content or make changes.
